szoveg_eredeti:
Congrats to the @SpaceX team on over 700 Falcon 9 flights!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-10-31T07:01:37+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2116425341371863312; média: 1 kép]
SpaceX has now crossed 700 Falcon 9 launches

700 missions flown by a single rocket family, at a scale and pace that have completely transformed modern spaceflight

Starlink 15-16 marked the 700th mission on October 27, with Starlink 15-18 following as the 701st on October 31

Since its first flight in 2010, Falcon 9 has revolutionized space transportation through reusable rocket technology

What once took years now happens every few days

SpaceX has turned launching and landing rockets into routine spaceflight

And that's an absolutely extraordinary engineering achievement
